#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The body of an svc job. Misconfigured -> runs ~2 s, logs one line, exits 1, writes NO rows (while svc
has already said "active"). Configured -> writes its rows under out/ and stays up until stopped."""
import os, sys, time

JOB, WORK = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]


def env_file(name):
    vals = {}
    try:
        for line in open(os.path.join(WORK, "jobs", name)):
            line = line.strip()
            if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line:
                k, _, v = line.partition("=")
                vals[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    except OSError:
        pass
    return vals


def stamp(msg):
    print(time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S ") + msg, flush=True)


def ingest():
    cfg = env_file("ingest.env")
    src = cfg.get("INGEST_SOURCE", "")
    path = os.path.join(WORK, src) if src else ""
    if not src or not os.path.isfile(path):
        time.sleep(2)
        stamp(f"ingest: source {src!r} not found; nothing to load, exiting")
        return 1
    rows = [l for l in open(path).read().splitlines()[1:] if l.strip()]
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(WORK, "out"), exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(WORK, "out", "ingest.rows"), "w") as f:
        for r in rows:
            f.write(r + "\n")
    stamp(f"ingest: loaded {len(rows)} rows from {src}")
    time.sleep(600)
    return 0


def exporter():
    cfg = env_file("exporter.env")
    port = cfg.get("EXPORTER_PORT", "")
    if not port.isdigit():
        time.sleep(2)
        stamp("exporter: EXPORTER_PORT not set; exiting")
        return 1
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(WORK, "out"), exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(WORK, "out", "metrics.rows"), "w") as f:
        for m in ("gateway_requests_total 1842", "gateway_errors_total 3", "cascade_escalations_total 41",
                  "ingest_rows_total 50", "exporter_up 1"):
            f.write(m + "\n")
    stamp(f"exporter: serving on :{port}")
    time.sleep(600)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit({"ingest": ingest, "exporter": exporter}[JOB]())
